comments.author: Meep
comments.body_html: I’d say that the updates on EFT revert it back to the old armor system (basically: more tanky, high pen ammo is meta), but now you can change the armor class of armors using plates. I believe that the armor plate update was great, but was incompatible with the player hitboxes, thus making armor less effective and not worth running.

comments.author: Meep
comments.body_html: Yes, It’ll work on any armor plate, as long as my mod is loaded after the custom armor plate.
